behaviors.name: Passive health regeneration
behaviors.value: 1% of MaxHealth per second (1 HP/s at MaxHealth=100)
behaviors.note: Default spawned-player Health script behavior, not a Humanoid scalar property. An empty Script named Health in StarterCharacterScripts disables the injected regeneration script.

behaviors.name: Climbing speed
behaviors.note: Documented Humanoid climbing behavior; controller choices and custom code may replace it.

behaviors.name: Default character camera
behaviors.value: Follows the character Humanoid; supports third person and first-person zoom
behaviors.note: StarterPlayer camera settings and the default PlayerModule control the behavior.

behaviors.name: Desktop movement and jump
behaviors.note: Conventional Roblox keyboard controls; custom input and selected movement modes may replace them.

behaviors.name: Avatar body and clothing
behaviors.value: Account, experience settings, HumanoidDescription, and rig dependent
behaviors.note: No universal skin color, asset IDs, body dimensions, scale, total mass, accessory list, or animation pack applies to all players. The rigs below are explicit samples.

behaviors.name: Custom gameplay stats
behaviors.note: Stamina, sprint speed, armor, mana, XP, levels, coins, kills, damage, cooldowns, hunger, thirst, inventory limits, and leaderstats must be defined by your game. A NumberValue defaults to 0 only after you create it; an absent stat is not implicitly 0.

behaviors.name: Animation IDs
behaviors.note: Default Animate assets can vary by rig, avatar animation packs, rollout, and replacement scripts. Asset ID 0 in a fresh HumanoidDescription means no explicit override, not an animation named 0.

behaviors.name: Physics values
behaviors.note: An unparented Part is not a HumanoidRootPart. Assembly mass, velocity, floor state, network ownership, and position depend on the live assembly. CanCollide differs by body part in the sample rigs.

behaviors.name: Units
behaviors.value: Distance: studs; normal speed: studs/s; gravity: studs/s²; angles: degrees; timers: seconds
behaviors.note: Boolean values are true/false; nil means no reference. A property marked serialized can be saved, but that does not guarantee write permission.

behaviors.name: Live account and client fields
behaviors.value: Not sampled: no Player is connected in edit mode
behaviors.note: UserId, username, DisplayName, AccountAge, locale, subscription, verification, party, platform, viewport, team, and character are not universal defaults. Device capability booleans captured in UserInputService describe this editor machine.
